description: This file declares the StorageManagerImplementation class, which implements storage management and configuration interfaces for a plugin in the WPEFramework. It includes class definitions, interface mappings, and method declarations related to storage operations.

classes.name: StorageManagerImplementation
classes.description: Implements storage management and configuration interfaces for the plugin, providing methods for creating, retrieving, deleting, and clearing storage, as well as configuration setup.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: A nested class within StorageManagerImplementation that manages JSON-based configuration, specifically the storage path.

methods.name: CreateStorage
methods.description: Creates storage for a given application ID with specified size, returning the storage path and error reason if any.

methods.name: GetStorage
methods.description: Retrieves storage details such as path, size, and used space for a specific application, user, and group.

methods.name: DeleteStorage
methods.description: Deletes storage associated with a specific application ID.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears storage for a specific application ID.

methods.name: ClearAll
methods.description: Clears storage for all applications except those specified.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the plugin with the provided shell service.
